context_for_next_testing_agent: Ensemble AI feature is fully functional. Backend APIs tested: GET /api/ensemble/status, POST /api/ensemble/predict/{coin_id}, POST /api/ensemble/rebuild-universe, GET /api/ensemble/build-status, GET /api/ensemble/optimal-universe, GET /api/ensemble/hidden-gems, GET /api/ensemble/comparison, GET /api/ensemble/weights, POST /api/ensemble/predict-batch, POST /api/ensemble/optimize-weights. Frontend page at /ensemble has status cards, rebuild section with progress bar, Top 10 coins list, Hidden Gems section, Portfolio Comparison, Model Weights display, and Universe Categories breakdown. Universe rebuild with 200+ coins takes ~1 minute.

Ensemble Status API.response: Returns ensemble_initialized: true, optimizer_initialized: true, deep_learning_available: true, model_weights

Universe Rebuild API.response: Starts background task, returns status: started

Build Status API.response: Returns running, progress (0-100), progress_message, coins_analyzed, total_coins

Optimal Universe API.response: Returns count: 30, coins with ensemble_score, top_10, categories breakdown

Hidden Gems API.response: Returns hidden_gems list (high score + low market cap coins), criteria explanation

Portfolio Comparison API.response: Returns overlap, added, removed coins, overlap_count, added_count, removed_count, avg scores

Model Weights API.response: Returns weights for all 7 models with descriptions

Batch Prediction API.response: Returns predictions for multiple coins, enforces max 20 limit

Optimize Weights API.response: Returns old_weights and new_weights after optimization
